svg.title: Fig. S1 Frozen cohort selection and registry geometry
svg.desc: Four panels reconcile the 1,465-candidate ledger, encode all 120 retained coordinates by 15 HUC2 categories without a basemap, show HUC2 counts, and report outcome-free registry proximity and repeated-HUC diagnostics.
